labels.rule: Shapes carry colour-2 connector dots; keeping the 4 block fixed, all other shapes are translated so that their connector dots coincide pairwise with those of already-placed shapes, assembling one connected structure.
labels.gap: Needs connector-matching assembly: search translations of many pieces so 2-dot pairs coincide, building a tree from the anchor piece.

labels.rule: The small 8 cross (four arms around an empty centre) is the seed of a four-armed rotating spiral: each arm keeps extending and turning in the same rotational direction with 1-cell gaps, filling the whole grid; the seed itself is erased.
labels.gap: Needs a turtle-like spiral-growth behaviour (extend, turn, keep gap) iterated to the grid border from each arm; rays are straight only.

labels.rule: Two noisy solid colour regions: stray pixels outside the regions are deleted, and each background hole inside a region becomes an 8 surrounded by a 3x3 ring painted in the other region's colour.
labels.gap: Needs noise-robust region segmentation plus a hole stamp whose colour is borrowed from the other region; chaining denoise and stamp is unsupported.

labels.rule: Several parallel line segments (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) share a start baseline; each is trimmed or extended along its direction to the length of the median/reference line.
labels.gap: Needs comparing line lengths across objects (median/reference) and extending or trimming each line, incl. diagonals, to that length.

labels.rule: The 3x3 motif in the 6x6 input is colour-inverted (shape->0, background->7) and tiled with period 3 (offset 1) into a fixed 16x16 grid; inside the central 6x6 square the 0 cells become 9.
labels.gap: Tiling exists, but needs motif extraction with colour inversion, phase-shifted tiling to a fixed non-multiple output size, and a constant central overlay chained together.

labels.rule: Amid border noise, a picture sits in the corner formed by two solid single-colour lines; the picture inside that L-frame (lines excluded) is cropped and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise (then flipped as needed).
labels.gap: Object select + D8 exists, but needs segmenting the picture bounded by touching frame lines amid noise, excluding the frame, before crop-and-rotate.

labels.rule: Each cell of a coloured sequence line emits diagonal rays forming nested chevrons (sequence repeated shifted along diagonals), and the edge marker bars flood their colour into the triangular regions bounded by those diagonals, leaving the rest background.
labels.gap: Needs diagonal rays from every sequence cell with overwrite order, then chained region fill by border marker colour inside the ray-bounded wedges.

labels.rule: Each small arrow-shaped object with one odd-coloured tip cell shoots a dotted (every second cell) ray of the tip colour in the direction it points, and the grid edge it hits is painted entirely in that colour (corner where two painted edges meet becomes 0).
labels.gap: Ray direction must be inferred from the arrow shape's orientation; needs period-2 dotted rays and painting the whole hit border line.

labels.rule: Small objects slide vertically as rigid bodies toward the border row of their own colour (top or bottom) until they touch that border or previously stacked objects.
labels.gap: Gravity direction must be chosen per object by matching its colour to the same-coloured border row.

labels.rule: The grid contains several crossing straight lines (horizontal, vertical, diagonal); output a 1-row list of their colours ordered by stacking depth, from the line drawn underneath to the line on top at crossings.
labels.gap: Needs occlusion relation between lines at crossing cells, a topological sort into depth order, and emitting colours as a sequence.

labels.rule: The centre cell has a colour matching one of the noisy quadrant patterns; erase everything and draw a diagonal ray from the centre cell toward the corner of the quadrant containing that colour.
labels.gap: Ray direction must be selected by matching centre colour to the quadrant with same-colour pattern; then clear all other content.

labels.rule: Vertical bars on the floor exchange attributes: bar colours rotate one step right (cyclically) while bar heights rotate one step left.
labels.gap: Needs object attribute decomposition (colour vs height) with separate cyclic permutations across the ordered set of bars.

labels.rule: A bent 5-coloured key path runs from a coloured end to a 4 end: the background becomes the end colour, the 3x3 ring is translated by the key's end-to-end displacement vector, and diagonal 4-lines radiate from the ring's corners to the grid edges.
labels.gap: Must read a glyph as a displacement vector plus background colour, translate the ring accordingly, then chain diagonal corner rays.

labels.rule: Each row has one dominant colour C plus noise; output row is C exactly where the input row is not C, and 0 elsewhere (complement of that colour's mask).
labels.gap: Needs a per-row (panel-by-row) dominant colour and mask-complement operation; no module keys rows as units with a complement.

labels.rule: Each 9-object contains a zigzag crack of 6 cells; the 6 cells are removed and the object splits along the crack into two halves that each move one cell away from the crack (perpendicular to it).
labels.gap: Needs splitting an object into parts along an internal marker line and moving each part apart, a part-level action.

labels.rule: Each colour-1 object is recoloured and pushed to a side edge (keeping its row): objects that are solid or have a fully enclosed hole become 2 and move to the left edge; objects whose hole is open to the outside become 3 and move to the right edge.
labels.gap: Needs open-vs-closed hole topology as a cue selecting both recolour and move direction to the grid edge per object.

labels.rule: Find the object whose holes (background-coloured gaps) exactly match the shapes of loose small pieces elsewhere; output that object cropped with its holes filled by the matching pieces' colours.
labels.gap: Needs shape-matching of loose pieces to holes, selecting the object they fit, and compositing pieces into holes.

labels.rule: In each multicolour 3x3 patch the four corner cells rotate 90 degrees counter-clockwise while the four edge-middle cells rotate 90 degrees clockwise; centre unchanged.
labels.gap: Needs part-wise transforms within an object (corners vs edges get opposite rotations), colour-agnostic; object-level D8 cannot split parts.

labels.rule: Within each row, when a specific colour pair occurs ({1,8} or {4,7}), the right-hand cell slides left until it touches the left-hand cell; other pairs stay put.
labels.gap: Move-until-contact must be gated by a learned colour-pair compatibility ({1,8},{4,7}) between single cells in the same row.

labels.rule: Every solid square loses its outer ring (shrinks by one cell on each side, 3x3 becomes its centre), while the single isolated cell grows into a 9x9 square centred on itself.
labels.gap: Needs colour-agnostic, size-keyed object change (erode ring / grow 1x1 to 9x9); test single cell has unseen colour 0.

labels.rule: The top-left motif (bordered by an L of a border colour) is expanded fractally: each foreground cell becomes a copy of the motif and each background cell becomes the motif recoloured with the border colour; this block pattern is then tiled to fill the grid.
labels.gap: Needs chained crop-motif, fractal self-substitution with border-colour recolour for background cells, then periodic tiling to the input size.

labels.rule: A corner legend of colour pairs (a b) says shape colour a gets a halo colour b: each shape's bounding box padded by one cell becomes a 7x7 square where exterior background is painted b (enclosed holes stay 0).
labels.gap: Legend lookup exists, but the action must be painting the padded-bbox exterior background around each shape, not recolouring or hole filling.

labels.rule: In a 1/0 checkerboard with one 8 on an edge, all 1s in each line slide toward the 8's edge (compacting); in the 8's own line the 1s pack against the 8 and an equal number of 9s is written right after them.
labels.gap: Needs cell-level compaction toward the marker's edge (direction from marker position) plus writing a run of 9s whose length equals the 1-count.

labels.rule: A cross of divider lines splits the grid off-centre; the pattern in one quadrant is mirrored across the divider lines into the other quadrants (4-fold reflection about the cross, clipped at the grid edge).
labels.gap: Mirror symmetry must use the off-centre separator lines as axes and allow clipping; self-model assumes grid-centred global symmetry.

labels.rule: Each interior object is an arrow; the frame cell where the arrow points (in line with its shaft) takes the arrow's colour and the frame cell at the opposite end of that line becomes 0.
labels.gap: Needs reading each object's pointing direction from its shape and marking frame cells at both ends of its axis.

labels.rule: Objects of size 4 or more fall straight down (rigidly) until they hit the bottom edge; objects of size 3 or less stay in place.
labels.gap: Gravity must apply only to objects passing a size threshold (>=4 cells); small objects are exempt.

labels.rule: The 8 rectangle projects bands of 4 (its full width vertically and full height horizontally) to all grid edges; the bands paint over background and colour-2 objects but pass beneath colour-1 objects.
labels.gap: Rays must be object-wide bands in four directions with colour-specific layering (overwrite 2, keep 1).

labels.rule: A diagonal 1-segment is extended as a ray; it passes straight through colour-3 lines (overwriting the crossing cell with 1) but reflects off colour-2 lines like a mirror, continuing to the grid edge.
labels.gap: Needs diagonal ray extension with reflection (bounce) at obstacles and colour-dependent pass-through vs reflect behaviour.

labels.rule: Draw an orthogonal path of 8 from one marker cell to the other, travelling alongside walls and crossing each wall line only through its gate (the middle of its coloured segment), overwriting the gate cell.
labels.gap: Needs path routing between two markers that threads through gate segments in successive wall lines.

labels.rule: In the 5x1 column swap the first two cells and swap the last two cells, keeping the middle cell; i.e. a fixed positional permutation regardless of colours.
labels.gap: Needs a learned fixed cell-position permutation (swap rows 0/1 and 3/4) with colours copied from input; not a D8 transform.

labels.rule: Several framed rectangles each carry small marker sub-patterns; output the largest frame with the smaller pieces nested inside it, each placed so that its marker pattern coincides with the matching marker in the frame that contains it (docking by shared marks).
labels.gap: Needs hierarchical assembly: nest objects inside one another by aligning matching sub-patterns, then crop to the outer frame.

labels.rule: Count the two scattered speck colours; output (fixed 16x16, background 7) a bottom-left rectangle of 2 whose height is the minority count and width the majority count, with a 4 V-shape of diagonals rising from its bottom corners.
labels.gap: Needs numerosity of colours mapped to rectangle dimensions, plus drawing a diagonal V pattern inside it.

labels.rule: Specks of 8 lying inside the 2 region are erased, while 8 specks lying in the 7 region grow by one cell toward the 9 border line (wherever that border is).
labels.gap: Speck action depends on enclosing region colour and growth direction comes from the distant 9 border; local tables lack this non-local cue.

labels.rule: Count the cells of each colour (non-background); render each colour as a solid k x k square with k*k = its count, arranged left to right in ascending size, bottom-aligned, separated by one background column.
labels.gap: Needs per-colour cell counts mapped to square sizes, sorting by count, and assembling a new output layout.

labels.rule: Scattered single noise cells are removed except that the repeated noise colour is drawn as a right triangle in the corner toward which the diagonal line shape points; triangle leg length appears to equal the number of noise cells minus one (unsure of exact size and colour-selection rule).
labels.gap: Needs noise-cell counting to size a corner triangle, choosing the corner from the line's pointing direction, and colour selection among noise.

labels.rule: Legend rows/columns outside a 2-coloured diamond give one colour per row/column; inside the diamond each such row/column is filled by a ray of its legend colour growing from the diamond edge on the legend's side until it hits an interior obstacle or the far edge.
labels.gap: Needs a position-aligned colour legend mapped to rows/columns, plus rays confined to the diamond interior that stop at obstacles.

labels.rule: Colour-mask fractal: each input cell of colour c is replaced by an n x n block equal to the input's mask of colour c painted in c (other cells 0).
labels.gap: Fractal variant where each block is the mask of cells equal to that cell's colour, not the plain non-zero mask.

labels.rule: Copy the objects of the small left panel into the empty wider right panel, keeping rows but re-laying out horizontally by anchoring: full-width bars stretch to the new width, left-aligned objects stay left, right-aligned objects move to the right side.
labels.gap: Needs anchor-aware non-uniform rescaling (stretch spans, preserve left/right alignment) from one panel to a differently sized panel.

labels.rule: Each 3x3 ring whose centre has colour c is repeated periodically (period 3) in the direction of the large object of colour c until it overlaps that object by two cells.
labels.gap: Needs directed periodic extension of an object toward a same-colour target with a stopping condition (overlap into target).

labels.rule: In a two-row alternating motif, every second motif row (the B rows) is cyclically shifted one cell to the right; the other rows are unchanged.
labels.gap: Needs a colour-agnostic row-wise cyclic shift applied to alternate rows; learned local patterns are tied to seen colours.

labels.rule: The motif at the bottom of the grid is tiled vertically upward with period equal to its height (aligned at the bottom), overwriting the empty background above.
labels.gap: Periodic extension must treat the uniform background region as unknown and use bottom-anchored vertical period equal to the motif height.

labels.rule: Keep only the two most frequent colours in the grid; every other colour becomes 7.
labels.gap: Needs global colour-frequency ranking (top-2 colours) to decide which cells are recoloured to 7.

labels.rule: A small block next to a larger block is pushed through it toward the grid edge (away from the third, anchor object); the pierced block splits in two with each half moving one cell outward to make room.
labels.gap: Needs an object-interaction behaviour: projectile passing through another object that splits and parts sideways; direction inferred from layout.

labels.rule: Horizontal lines divide the grid into bands each holding a striped pattern of the line colour; output 3x5: per band a bar of its colour whose length equals the number of solid rows in its pattern, a 9 column, and a 5 marking one band (selection rule for the 5 unclear).
labels.gap: Needs counting repeated pattern rows per band, emitting counts as bar lengths in a summary grid, and placing the 5 indicator.

labels.rule: In a 3x3 panel grid, two panels holding the 2-motif define an orientation; empty panels are filled with 5- and 8-coloured copies of the motif to complete a fixed Y-shaped configuration rotated in 45-degree steps around the centre panel (one demo with an already complete configuration maps to a blank 16x16 grid).
labels.gap: Needs a panel-level configuration template matched under 45-degree rotations of the 8-neighbour ring, then recoloured motif copies placed.

labels.rule: Count the 8-connected objects of each colour and draw a bottom-aligned bar chart (5 columns, height = max count): each colour gets a fixed column (5,2,8,9,6 order) with bar height equal to its object count.
labels.gap: Needs per-colour object counting rendered as a histogram with a learned colour-to-column assignment and count-dependent output height.

labels.rule: From the given 7/3 row, build rows downward every second row: a cell gets a colour where the row two above has a 3 flanked by two coloured cells, alternating 6 and 7 per generation, until no cells qualify (shrinking pyramid).
labels.gap: Needs an iterated cellular-automaton step (local rule applied generation by generation with alternating output colour) until extinction.

labels.rule: Each object resting on the 8 floor moves straight up by a number of rows equal to its own cell count.
labels.gap: Translation distance must equal the object's size; dynamics only moves fixed offsets or until contact.

labels.rule: The input is a lattice of separator rows/columns with content blocks; delete the separator/frame rows and columns and concatenate the remaining content cells (blocks at lattice positions) into a compact grid that shows the drawn path.
labels.gap: Needs detecting irregular lattice/separator rows and columns and gluing the surviving sub-blocks into a new grid.

labels.rule: The objects touching the four grid corners are cycled clockwise: each corner object is translated (unrotated) so that it sits in the next corner clockwise; all other objects stay.
labels.gap: Needs selecting corner-anchored objects and a group-level cyclic permutation of corner positions with corner-anchored placement.

labels.rule: In a noisy grid, solid monochrome regions are crossed by short paths of foreign (noise) cells; each such path is recoloured to the colour of its head cell (e.g. the cell at the region's edge), making a clean line through the region.
labels.gap: Needs segmenting solid regions within dense random noise and identifying the foreign path inside, then recolouring it with its endpoint colour.

labels.rule: Two 9 markers sit outside an 8 wall structure; recolour to 9 the route along the 8 wall lines connecting the two markers, taking the side of the structure away from the 7 cells (7s mark compartments the route must avoid).
labels.gap: Needs path search along wall segments between two markers with avoidance constraints set by 7 cells.

labels.rule: Diamond outlines are rescaled about their centres by colour: colour-2 diamonds shrink by one step (radius minus 1), colour-5 diamonds grow by one (a single 5 becomes a radius-1 ring), other colours unchanged; partially off-grid diamonds included.
labels.gap: Needs concentric scaling of diamond rings (incl. off-grid centres), with direction chosen by object colour.

labels.rule: A dotted 4 outline on the dot lattice becomes a solid frame; the dotted coloured pieces outside are solidified (filled across the lattice gaps) and packed inside the frame side by side in their original left-right/top-bottom order with one-cell gaps, and removed from outside.
labels.gap: Needs lattice-aware solidification of dotted pieces and ordered packing of several pieces into a frame interior.

labels.rule: Several arrow-like objects point their 1-cell tips at a common centre; the dominant one (apparently the largest) keeps its tip and grows one full row/column at its back, while every other object loses its tip cell.
labels.gap: Needs relational comparison among converging objects (winner by size) and two different object actions: tip removal vs back extension.

labels.rule: For each horizontal bar, write a single cell in the 5-marker's column on the bar's row whose colour encodes the bar's length (2->1, 3->4, 4->9, 5->6).
labels.gap: Needs object length measured and mapped through a learned length-to-colour code, written at the marker column.

labels.rule: Between the 1 region (top) and 6 region (bottom) with a jagged boundary, draw a 9 line from the top down the column where the 1 region reaches deepest, and a 4 line from the top down the column of the 6 region's highest peak, stopping at the 6.
labels.gap: Needs boundary extremum detection (deepest/highest column of a region) to select where vertical rays of fixed colours are drawn.

labels.rule: The grid is a lattice of identical 5x5 tiles except one corrupted tile; output the normal tile with 1 written at every cell where the corrupted tile differs from it.
labels.gap: Panel module needs majority tile vs odd-one-out difference overlay, marking mismatching cells with a new colour 1.

labels.rule: The grid consists of vertical colour bands of varying width (with sprinkled noise cells) that are reordered as rigid units; usually the first band moves to the end (cyclic left rotation), but one demo instead reverses, so the ordering cue (possibly the noise) is unclear.
labels.gap: Needs segmenting colour bands (no separator lines) and permuting them as units with their internal noise; ordering rule unresolved.

labels.rule: Two crossing marker-bearing lines are replaced by a compact woven block bounded by the marker positions: rows alternate between the cross-line colour and patterns interleaving marker colours with the other line's colour (exact construction unclear).
labels.gap: Needs reading both lines' marker sequences and composing them into a 2D woven pattern within a marker-defined box.

labels.rule: Cells of the same colour (two or more) are joined into one connected orthogonal path (straight or L-shaped segments) in that colour, routed around the 8 walls; singleton colours are left alone.
labels.gap: Connect handles only aligned straight segments; needs L-shaped/tree routing between same-colour cells with obstacle avoidance.

labels.rule: The 7 block travels along its row/column band to the 9 block's position (replacing it, its old spot cleared); every gate of 0-dot pairs it passes through on the way gets its gap filled with 2.
labels.gap: Needs move-to-target (block onto same-size target) plus marking the traversed gates with a trace colour.

labels.rule: The red shape slides toward the 2x2 grey block until it touches it, and the grey block is reshaped into the mirror image of the red shape reflected across the contact line.
labels.gap: Move-until-contact exists, but chaining it with reshaping the target object into the reflected copy of the mover is missing.

labels.rule: Every square object (equal height and width, solid or hollow, any size/colour) gets red marks on the two cells orthogonally outside each of its four bbox corners; non-square objects are unchanged.
labels.gap: Behaviour keys need a colour- and size-independent shape class 'is square (h==w)' so corner marks generalise to unseen colour/size.

labels.rule: Each multi-colour template shape contains one anchor-coloured cell; copies of the template are stamped at every isolated cell of that anchor colour, the original template is erased, and grey noise cells are deleted.
labels.gap: No operator to stamp a template object at all marker cells matching its anchor colour (copy-to-marker), with template removal.

labels.rule: Remove the plus-shaped object and paint the centre cell of every odd-sided square of the main colour with the plus's colour; even-sided squares stay unchanged.
labels.gap: Mark colour comes from an indicator plus that varies per demo; also needs 'centre of odd square' for unseen sizes (7x7).

labels.rule: The grid is three 5x5 panels split by magenta lines, each holding one object; output is a 5x5 panel where the objects are stacked bottom-up in panel order (left panel lowest), keeping their columns, rows packed with no gaps.
labels.gap: Panels are split, but output needs vertical concatenation/stacking of each panel's object rows, not a cellwise vote or overlay.

labels.rule: Crop the grey mask shape; at each mask cell output the colour of the key's patterned row at that column, at each non-mask cell the colour of the key's fill row.
labels.gap: Needs mask-select between two key rows broadcast down the columns; key and mask are separate unequal-size objects, not separator panels.

labels.rule: The input is a sequence of equal panels in which an inner shape grows by one cell per step (last panel blank); output is the next panel with the shape grown by one more step.
labels.gap: No sequence extrapolation across panels: infer per-step growth of a shape and render the next term.

labels.rule: All framed window objects share a compartment layout; the colours filled into compartments of any window are pooled by compartment position and every window (whatever its size) gets all its compartments filled accordingly.
labels.gap: Needs part-level object model (window -> compartments) and transfer of compartment fills across windows of different sizes.

labels.rule: A top-left key lists colour pairs a->b; each dot-lattice object of colour a gets every surrounding background cell within its 3x3 neighbourhood filled with b, with overlaps drawn in key-row priority (first row on top).
labels.gap: 2-cell legend exists, but legend must drive a halo/dilation action per object with z-order taken from legend row order.

labels.rule: The sparse lattice of coloured dots is upscaled into a fixed 26x26 canvas of blocks (block size set by lattice dimensions, 2-cell gaps/margins), with horizontally adjacent same-colour cells merged into one block, and vertical merges only for cells not merged horizontally.
labels.gap: Upscale to fixed canvas with variable block size plus merging adjacent equal-colour cells into rectangles; only fixed-factor upscale exists.

labels.rule: The grid is a periodic background pattern divided into panels by yellow/teal lines; a rectangular group of panels is filled with solid colours, and the output is that group downscaled to one cell per panel.
labels.gap: Panel downscale exists; needs restricting to panels of uniform colour (those breaking the periodic pattern) and cropping to their bounding block.

labels.rule: Among vertical teal line segments, one has its top or bottom half coloured maroon; that maroon half is removed and painted onto the same half (top/bottom) of the segment whose length is exactly 2 greater.
labels.gap: Needs ranking/comparison of segment lengths (find the line of length L+2) and transfer of a half-segment recolouring to it.

labels.rule: Within each separator-bounded group of four blocks: if a yellow line divides the group, swap the blocks across that line (left/right or top/bottom); otherwise recolour all blue placeholder blocks to the group's single other colour.
labels.gap: Needs per-group selection between swap-across-divider and fill-placeholders, cued by presence/orientation of a yellow divider line.

labels.rule: Each solid rectangle beside the separator line is mirrored across that line, and the gap between the rectangle and its mirror copy is filled with the separator colour, overwriting noise dots.
labels.gap: Needs per-object reflection across a line object plus bridging fill between original and copy; only global symmetry and same-colour connect exist.

labels.rule: Panels come in left/right pairs, each a background with one shape; the shapes are swapped between the paired panels and each moved shape is drawn in its source panel's background colour, while pairs with equal backgrounds are cleared.
labels.gap: Needs cross-panel object swap with colour remapping to the source background, and a same-background condition that erases both shapes.

labels.rule: A bar of length n in colour c becomes, in raster order across the grid width, runs of length 1,2,...,n,...,2,1 separated by single blank cells, with height as needed.
labels.gap: Needs reading a count (bar length) and generating a counted sequence of runs written in raster (row-wrapped) order.

labels.rule: The grid is three equal panels split by magenta lines; the output panel takes its left column band from panel 1, middle band from panel 2 and right band from panel 3 (bands 2/1/2 wide for 5-wide panels, 2/2/2 for 6-wide).
labels.gap: Panel split exists; output must be assembled from a different column band of each panel (band k from panel k), not a cellwise vote.

labels.rule: Tiles in a separator lattice are either a fixed two-colour pattern or a solid minority-colour block, with grey noise on top; output swaps them: pattern tiles become solid majority colour, solid tiles receive the clean pattern, noise removed.
labels.gap: Needs per-tile type classification under noise and swapping roles of pattern tile and solid tile; no tile-level rewrite with denoising.

labels.rule: Remove the border frame; extend the green band lines across the whole grid, and extend each red segment perpendicular to the band out to the grid edges as rays in the frame colour.
labels.gap: Rays exist, but ray colour must be bound to the frame colour, combined with frame deletion and line extension through the frame.

labels.rule: Drop the left marker column and cyclically shift the remaining rows downward by the row index of the red marker cell in that column.
labels.gap: Toroidal shift exists, but the shift amount must be read from a marker's position (row index) and the marker column removed.

labels.rule: Teal marks on one border: length-1 marks grow to length 2, while length-2 marks are erased and instead cut a 2-cell black notch at the opposite end of the same row/column.
labels.gap: Length-2 marks have a non-local effect (notch at the far opposite edge), beyond radius-4 local change tables.

labels.rule: Crop to the first three rows; the third row becomes a copy of the top row with its non-background colour replaced by magenta (6).
labels.gap: Crop exists; needs one extra step writing row 0 into row 2 with the non-background colour remapped to 6.

labels.rule: Floating shapes fall straight down toward the floor region but stop leaving exactly one empty row between them and the floor (the floor's own shape below each object determines its stop).
labels.gap: Gravity-until-contact exists; needs a stop-one-cell-short offset (resting gap of 1) instead of contact.

labels.rule: Several coloured L/bar fragments scattered on the background are the pieces of a square ring; assemble them (translation only) into a closed square frame, with the background colour filling its interior, and output that square.
labels.gap: Needs puzzle-style assembly: find placements so fragments jointly form a closed rectangular frame.

labels.rule: Split the input into top and bottom halves; output places the top half with a maroon column on its right, then a full maroon row, then the bottom half with a maroon column on its left (halves offset diagonally by one).
labels.gap: Needs splitting the grid into halves and reassembling them with a one-cell offset and a maroon separator cross.

labels.rule: The coloured regions surrounding the central yellow/orange shape exchange colours by a cyclic shift: each region takes the colour of its neighbouring region one step anticlockwise (colours rotate clockwise around the centre); shapes stay fixed.
labels.gap: Needs ordering regions cyclically around a centre and recolouring each with its neighbour's colour (a colour permutation derived from spatial relations).

labels.rule: The top strip holds small glyphs; the framed box shows a partially revealed block-scaled pattern; output is the frame with its interior completed as the glyph (matching the block grid and the revealed blocks) drawn at block scale in the interior colour.
labels.gap: Needs matching a partial block-scaled pattern to a legend glyph (scale-invariant subset match) and rendering the full glyph upscaled inside the frame.

labels.rule: Every object moves straight down by a number of cells equal to its own cell count (clipped at the grid edge).
labels.gap: Translation exists, but displacement must equal each object's size (numerosity-driven move distance).

labels.rule: Each 2-cell segment extends into a full line along its own axis: horizontal pairs fill their whole row, vertical pairs fill their whole column, with row lines drawn over column lines.
labels.gap: Rays exist but in fixed directions; ray axis must follow each segment's orientation, with horizontal lines taking priority over vertical.

labels.rule: Delete every foreign-colour cell/fragment that lies inside or within the concavity of another colour's outline shape; fragments lying outside any shape are kept.
labels.gap: Needs an 'inside / within hull of another object' relation to delete intruders; fill-enclosed only treats fully closed background.

labels.rule: The grey cell moves straight toward the black staircase region until blocked, then slides diagonally along the region's edge while staying adjacent to it, stopping when blocked or when it would lose contact.
labels.gap: Move-until-contact exists; needs a follow-up trajectory sliding diagonally along an obstacle's edge with a contact-based stopping rule.

labels.rule: Each row's middle-colour run slides left through the left-colour region until its right end reaches the leftmost right edge of that run over all rows (or it hits the wall); the displaced left-colour cells reappear on its right.
labels.gap: Needs per-row sliding with a stopping line set globally (min right edge across rows) and displaced-fluid refill; gravity stops only at contact.

labels.rule: Each colour has a fixed glyph shape (consistent across demos) drawn on a horizontal line; erase the existing glyph and, for each pair of border marker cells, draw a line across that row plus that colour's glyph at its usual column.
labels.gap: Needs a cross-demo memory binding colour -> glyph shape/position, retrieved when only marker cells of that colour appear.

labels.rule: Each cluster consists of a blue chevron and a 5-cell coloured plus; the whole cluster moves two cells in the chevron-to-plus direction and the plus is rotated 180 degrees (its colours reversed).
labels.gap: Needs a part-level rule: rigid translation of a composite object plus 180-degree rotation of its coloured sub-part, independent of the specific colours.

labels.rule: The grid holds 3x3 ring nodes (ring colour + centre colour) linked by colour-coded dotted paths; output is one node, apparently the endpoint reached by following the colour-coded path network (exact selection criterion unclear).
labels.gap: Needs graph/pointer following over dotted colour-coded paths between nodes; property-based object selection cannot identify the target node.

labels.rule: The grey comb (solid top plus teeth) jumps to the opposite side of the grid, its teeth sheared diagonally one cell per row back toward its old side, and the floor row under the vacated span turns maroon.
labels.gap: Needs non-rigid shear deformation of an object's teeth plus mirror relocation and a floor mark spanning the remaining width.

labels.rule: Recolour each red shape by its mirror-symmetry axis: symmetric about a horizontal axis -> blue, vertical axis -> green, diagonal axis -> magenta; isolated single cells are erased.
labels.gap: Symmetry key is lost in D8-canonical frames; needs absolute symmetry-axis type (H/V/diagonal) as the key, singletons deleted.

labels.rule: Each isolated dot aligned with a same-colour bar is joined to it by a 1-wide line; the bar gets a 3-cell nub where the line leaves, and the dot becomes a hollow diamond (its four neighbours filled, centre cleared).
labels.gap: Connect-aligned exists for same-colour cells; needs bar-to-dot connection plus decorations at both ends (edge nub, hollow diamond).

labels.rule: In a noisy lattice of separator lines, four line crossings are interrupted (background colour); output is the crop of the rectangle whose corners are those interrupted crossings.
labels.gap: Needs crop delimited by anomalous lattice intersections (gaps in separator lines) rather than fixed corners or selected objects.

labels.rule: Framed boxes containing glyphs are linked in a loop by blue lines; each glyph keeps its shape but takes the colour of the glyph in the next box along the loop (cyclic colour shift).
labels.gap: Needs graph relation 'next box along connecting line loop' and recolouring each glyph by its neighbour's colour.

labels.rule: Each black rectangle touching a grid edge slides straight across to the opposite edge, and every cell in the band it sweeps through is cleaned to orange (grey noise erased).
labels.gap: Needs a slide-to-opposite-border action that ignores obstacles and wipes its swept band; move stops at contact and leaves no trail.

labels.rule: Starting from the top row of red/grey cells, grow a downward triangle: each new cell under a gap is the colour opposite to its upper-left parent when both diagonal parents are coloured, repeated row by row until it narrows out.
labels.gap: Needs iterated application of a local two-parent rule row by row (1-D cellular automaton growth), not one-shot pattern rewriting.

labels.rule: Corner cells act as colour keys; each small two-colour shape whose odd cell matches a corner colour has its two colours swapped, and a glyph in that corner colour is drawn in the matching corner (exact glyph derivation unclear).
labels.gap: Needs corner-marker keys linking shapes to corners, colour swap within shapes, and building a corner glyph from the linked shapes.

labels.rule: Count the cells of each colour and redraw the grid as a sorted histogram: colours in descending frequency fill columns from left to right, each column filled bottom-to-top, preserving all counts.
labels.gap: Needs per-colour counting, sorting by frequency, and re-emitting cells in column-major fill order.

labels.rule: Several overlapping rectangular outlines of different colours are stacked; output is a set of concentric square rings ordered by stacking depth (bottom-most outline outermost, top-most innermost, a single centre cell).
labels.gap: Needs inferring occlusion (drawn-over) order between outlines and rendering them as concentric rings in that order.

labels.rule: Bars hanging from the top edge (with full-height blocks as dividers) are re-encoded into a 10-row output with bars hanging from the top and rising from the bottom; the exact length/position mapping (possibly a counting code) is unclear to me.
labels.gap: Output layout is computed from bar lengths/positions (a numeric re-encoding); no module derives geometry from counted bar lengths.

labels.rule: Normalise the framed object to a 5x5 frame (corners blank) holding the 3x3 window centred on its interior content, then draw two copies in a 15x15 canvas at fixed diagonal offsets (2,2) and (8,8).
labels.gap: Needs resizing a frame object to a canonical size around its content plus fixed-position duplication; no frame-normalising rescale exists.

labels.rule: Replace the scattered object with a horizontal line in its colour whose length equals the object's cell count, centred horizontally on the grid's middle row.
labels.gap: Needs numerosity: count an object's cells and draw a centred line of that length.

labels.rule: Two yellow notched brackets sit in opposite corners; the loose small object is moved to the bottom edge directly beneath the notch of the top bracket (the free bottom corner), keeping its shape.
labels.gap: Needs placement by alignment relation to another object's notch (column of top bracket's gap) plus moving to the bottom edge.

labels.rule: The 6x6 input shows a right-angle corner with arms of length k in one corner; output is a 16x16 canvas with, in the same corner, a right triangle whose arms are length 2k and whose hypotenuse is a diagonal line (outline only).
labels.gap: Needs scaling a corner shape by 2 about its corner and completing it into a triangle with a diagonal hypotenuse, on a fixed canvas.

labels.rule: The grid is a lattice of equal panels; one panel holds a template shape and some panels contain a single black hole cell; the template is copied into every panel with a hole (hole erased), others unchanged.
labels.gap: Needs panel-level copy: write the template panel into all panels flagged by a hole marker; panel ops only vote/overlay into one output.

labels.rule: In a noisy grey/orange grid, grey cells forming diagonal staircase lines (chains of cells stepping diagonally, possibly 2 wide) are recoloured teal; other grey cells stay (exact line criterion unclear).
labels.gap: Needs recognising diagonal/staircase line structures within dense noise; simple diagonal-run detection explains only part of the recoloured cells.

labels.rule: Two 3x3 squares sit in opposite corners; every stray cell of a square's colour is pulled toward that square (straight if aligned with its rows/cols, otherwise diagonally) until it touches it.
labels.gap: Move-until-contact exists but in fixed directions; needs attraction toward the same-colour anchor object (8 directions) per stray cell.

labels.rule: Several objects of different colours are copies of one symmetric template shape with some cells missing; each object is completed to the full template shape in its own colour.
labels.gap: Self-similarity repair must work per object across colours (colour-agnostic template consensus or per-object symmetry), not global grid symmetry.

labels.rule: A pair of grey marker cells near one edge indicates a half: crop the grid to the half (top/bottom if the pair is vertical, left/right if horizontal) containing the markers, and erase the markers to background.
labels.gap: Crop exists for fixed corners; needs half-crop whose axis and side are chosen by a marker pair's orientation and position, markers erased.

labels.rule: The two-colour object (stacked identical halves) swaps its outline and fill colours; its top half is slid right until its bottom-left corner touches the bottom half's top-right corner diagonally, while the bottom half stays.
labels.gap: Needs splitting an object into parts, a relative move of one part to diagonal contact, and swapping its two colours.
